in_sanskrit.name: अक्षय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is invulnerable, the one who is immortal, the imperishable, the one whose death is impossible.

in_marathi.name: अक्षय
in_marathi.long_meaning: अक्षय हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अक्षय’, meaning ‘infinite’, ‘endless’, or ‘unending’. The name ‘अक्षय’ is a tribute to the divine qualities of immortality, invincibility, and the power to overcome obstacles. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as ‘अक्षय’, symbolizing his infinite nature.
